name: valve_raven_fire_trap
note: Ravenholm's alley fire trap (d1_town_01): Grigori's gas line along the foot of a house wall down a 128-wide alley, five burners each with a spark plug, fire nodes and heat shimmer; a valve wheel at the alley's end turns the gas on, a red button beside it (or a shot or blast near the gas) lights it, turning the wheel back puts it out

trigger.name: hallfire_1_trap_1_light_rl
trigger.what: gas on and lit, as Grigori does

trigger.name: hallfire_1_trap_1_out_rl
trigger.what: gas off, the fire goes out
